pre_registered_reading: per side, New York clock: PAYOUT-CLEARED iff >= 12 of 15 CPCV paths have >= 25 priced trades, expected value per unit staked at the reconstructed payout is above 0 on >= 12 of them and the p10 of their expected values is >= 0, else NOT CLEARED AT THE QUOTED PAYOUT; ADVERSELY PRICED iff on >= 12 counted paths the trades' mean payout is >= 0.02 below the always-side mean payout, FAVOURABLY PRICED iff >= 0.02 above on >= 12, else NEUTRAL; the fixed UTC-4 clock, the favoured/unfavoured split and the payout floors are descriptive and change no verdict

UP.verdict: NOT CLEARED AT THE QUOTED PAYOUT

DOWN.verdict: NOT CLEARED AT THE QUOTED PAYOUT

assumptions: the pricing rule of 2026-07-02..2026-07-31 is applied to other dates unchanged (not checkable on disk)
clock=ny: the daily pattern follows the New York clock all year; clock=utc4: it stays at the UTC times of July (the archive has summer dates only, so it cannot tell the two apart)
a pair without a quote lane is priced by the rule of the six quoted pairs (see leave_one_pair_out)
